§6Arcane Additions

A collection of enchantments to enhance vanilla gameplay.

Turn the page to learn about each enchantment.

§cBulwark

§0Applies to: Shields
Slot: Offhand
Max Level: III

Increases armor by 2 / 4 / 6 while the shield is held in the offhand.

§cFortify

§0Applies to: Chestplates
Max Level: III

Increases armor by 2 / 4 / 6.

§cSwift Harness

§0Applies to: Harnesses
Max Level: III

Increases flying speed by 0.01 / 0.02 / 0.03 per level.

§cEnsnare

§0Applies to: Pickaxes
Max Level: I

Break a monster spawner with this enchantment to pick it up as an item, preserving its mob and settings.

Place the item to restore the spawner.

Silk Touch alone, or an empty spawner, only drops XP.
